links.outcome: Readability of LLM patient education outputs versus recommended sixth-grade reading level
links.effect: All model outputs surpassed the American Medical Association's recommended sixth-grade reading level for patient materials.
links.quote: Readability analyses revealed that all model outputs surpassed the American Medical Association's recommended sixth-grade reading level for patient materials.

links.outcome: Plain-language comprehensibility of LLM patient education outputs via readability indices
links.effect: All model outputs exceeded the sixth-grade reading level recommended for patient materials (Flesch–Kincaid, Gunning Fog, Flesch Reading Ease).
links.quote: Readability analyses revealed that all model outputs surpassed the American Medical Association's recommended sixth-grade reading level for patient materials.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates responses from several LLMs to patient queries on multidrug-resistant organism infections using expert ratings and readability metrics, but it does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
